Bundled third-party assets
==========================

This folder contains unmodified MediaPipe Tasks Vision runtime files and the
MediaPipe gesture recognizer model, used only for optional camera gesture
control. MediaPipe is distributed under the Apache License 2.0; the full
license text is included as LICENSE-2.0.txt.

Files:
- vision_bundle.mjs
- wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js
- wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm
- wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.js
- wasm/vision_wasm_nosimd_internal.wasm
- gesture_recognizer.task

All files are served locally from this repository. No camera frames are sent
to a server; recognition runs in the browser. The camera is activated only
after the visitor chooses "启用手势". If the model or camera is unavailable,
the particle memory tree remains fully usable with buttons, mouse and touch.
